scope: main circuit, separate corner curbs, edge lines, source-derived runoff, approximate pit lane and pit wall; existing grass platform; no buildings or stands

pitLane.layout: approximate parallel pit lane with blended entry/exit; not a surveyed pit route

limitations: CSV contains a smoothed 2D centerline and estimated widths, not a survey of the 2025 layout.
GLB supplies elevation after a similarity alignment; local surface samples and banking are smoothed.
Corner curb zones are inferred from curvature; exact paint and curb extents are approximations.
Pit lane is a parallel approximation; buildings, stands and a new grass floor are omitted.
Rectangular segments still have small overlapping joins; no wedges or mesh uploads are used.
Placement and driving require live verification with the current catalog.
